paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. When Ahaziah got hurt, he had a real question: will I get better? He just took it to the wrong place, Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron (2 Kings 1:2). The LORD's question through Elijah, "Is it because there is no God in Israel…" (2 Kings 1:3), is aimed right at that. Where we carry our biggest worries says who we really trust.

Now look at the three captains. The first two went up to Elijah on that hill with the king's order, "Come down!" and "Come down at once!", and fire came down both times (2 Kings 1:9-12). The third captain came on his knees, saying, "may my life… be precious in your sight" (2 Kings 1:13-14). Friend, you can't boss God's word around or outnumber it, and I think that third captain knew it.

And the word the LORD spoke didn't budge. Ahaziah heard it by messenger, then again face to face, and both times it was the same: "You will surely die." (2 Kings 1:16). Ahaziah died "according to the word of the LORD" (2 Kings 1:17). So when something hits you, baker, take it to the God who said it and does it, because His word still stands when nobody wants to hear it.
